identity.name: USB Removable Media Exfiltration of Sensitive Customer Records
identity.summary: An insider or compromised account copies files containing unencrypted payment card information (PCI) and personally identifiable information (PII) to an external removable storage volume.
identity.description: Removable storage devices remain a major physical exfiltration vector for malicious insiders and rogue operators. Cortex XDR Endpoint DLP inspects file write and copy operations targeting USB mass storage mounts, evaluating content for credit card PANs, SSNs, and sensitive structured data patterns.

techniques.name: Exfiltration Over Physical Medium: Exfiltration over USB

prerequisites.description: Cortex XDR Endpoint DLP enabled agent.

biocs.name: PCI and PII Data Staging
biocs.logic: preset = xdr_data | filter event_type = 'FILE_WRITE' and (action_file_name contains 'pci' or action_file_name contains 'pii') and (action_file_path contains '/tmp/' or action_file_path contains 'AppData')

biocs.name: USB Media Data Copy
biocs.logic: preset = xdr_data | filter event_type = 'FILE_WRITE' and (action_file_device_type = 'REMOVABLE' or action_file_path contains 'mock_usb' or action_file_path contains 'Volumes' or action_file_path contains 'media') and (action_file_name contains '.csv' or action_file_name contains '.xlsx')

xql_queries.name: Endpoint DLP Removable Media Transfer
xql_queries.query: dataset = xdr_data | filter event_sub_type in ('FILE_CREATED', 'FILE_MODIFIED') | filter action_file_path contains 'usb' or action_file_device_type = 'REMOVABLE' | comp count() as writes by agent_hostname, actor_process_username | filter writes >= 1

correlation_rules.name: Sensitive File Staged and Copied to Removable Device
correlation_rules.logic: Sequence: File Write (PCI CSV) -> File Copy to Removable Storage Mount within 120s by same user

references.title: Unit 42 - Defending Against Insider Threat Exfiltration
